sources.title: Amazon, Synopsys to cut more than 275 Bay Area tech jobs
sources.description: Amazon is eliminating 148 jobs in San Francisco and Sunnyvale as Synopsys prepares to cut another 128 positions at its Silicon Valley campus.

sources.title: Synopsys to Slash 2,000 Jobs After $35 Bn Ansys Merger and China Slowdown – Outlook Business
sources.description: The layoffs follow Synopsys’ $35 billion acquisition of engineering design firm Ansys, marking a major strategic shift as the company integrates operations and reallocates resources. Despite strong client ties with Nvidia, Intel, and Qualcomm, Synopsys has faced a slowdown in China due to export restrictions and challenges with a key foundry partner, pressuring its growth outlook
